fact: Alfred Wegener proposed continental drift in 1912.
Pangaea began to break apart about 200 million years ago.
The lithosphere plates ride on the ductile asthenosphere.
Plates move about 2 to 10 centimeters per year.
The Mid-Atlantic Ridge is a divergent boundary.
Harry Hess proposed seafloor spreading in 1962.
Vine and Matthews explained the symmetric magnetic stripes as a record of magnetic reversals.
The oldest ocean floor is about 180 million years old.
Oceanic lithosphere subducts beneath continental lithosphere because it is denser.
The Himalayas formed where the Indian Plate meets the Eurasian Plate.
The San Andreas Fault lies between the Pacific Plate and the North American Plate.
The Mariana Trench is about 11,000 m deep.
The Ring of Fire holds about 75% of the world's active volcanoes.
Hawaii formed over a hot spot, not at a plate boundary.
Slab pull is considered the strongest driving force.
